description: A simple mod which adds additional wood types to charm and environmental's woodcutters

mods.name: Woodcutter Compats
mods.description:
A compatability mod which adds recipes from various biome mods to Charm's woodcutter and Environmental's sawmill.

Currently Supported: BYG, Atmospheric, Autumnity, Abundance, Environmental, Tinker's Contruct

releases.notes:
**Release 1.2** (Critical Fix Update)

- Fixed a critical issue where recipes including stripped logs would not work due to a typo in recipe generation
- Added override for Rosewood (Atmospheric) so stripped versions of it would work (inconsistent naming)
- Fixed recipes for BYG's "stem" wood types as they use slightly inconsistent naming schemes
- Added override for palo_verde as it is cut into birch planks
- Fixed wood types which did not have boats (ether, embur, lament, nightshade and the stems)
